title: Reject non-finite calculated unit conversions
source: lib/ohworks-unit-conversion.ts:154-156 and :189-209 validate only the input and can overflow during conversion or rounding. Inline reproduction: GLUCOSE, Number.MAX_VALUE, mmol/L to mg/dL returns value Infinity. Planning verification on ef1f4da1633e6d4e90348ea613055691f1131580: the eight assigned existing test files passed 291/291 tests using TSX_DISABLE_CACHE=1 node --import /private/tmp/actorlab-654-review-base/node_modules/tsx/dist/loader.mjs --test followed by their exact paths (read-only existing loader; no dependency installation). All eight defect reproductions were separately asserted inline against unchanged source. Standalone source-verified bug; reviewed held issues #72, #94, #95 are not fully closed by this change.
prompt:
Make the synthetic analyte unit converter reject non-finite calculated output. lib/ohworks-unit-conversion.ts:189-193 validates that the input is finite, but lines 196-209 return unchecked multiplication or division results. The rounding helper at lines 154-156 also multiplies by a decimal scale without checking overflow. An inline reproduction using GLUCOSE, Number.MAX_VALUE, fromUnit mmol/L, and toUnit mg/dL returned a frozen result containing Infinity rather than a typed failure.

Compute the converted value before constructing the result, and enforce a finite-output invariant through the existing UnitConversionError mechanism. Add an explicit conversion-overflow error code and explanation for unrepresentable output. Make rounding avoid intermediate overflow when the converted value itself remains representable; do not change analyte factors, normal rounding precision, or accepted unit pairs. Keep the implementation dependency-free and limited to this module.

Extend tests/ohworks/unit-conversion.test.ts to cover division overflow, multiplication overflow using the declared creatinine pair, a large representable value that previously overflowed only during decimal scaling, and unchanged ordinary round trips. Update its error-code expectations where necessary. Run node --import tsx --test tests/ohworks/unit-conversion.test.ts. Assert error class and code, plus finite output for accepted values. work on the assigned branch you are on. Edit only the listed source and test; no merges, rebases, commits, pushes, database work, configuration changes, or external calls.
